checks.do: Which of the four score bands a Health360 score falls in, and which time range the dashboard or page is set to, before comparing two scores.

what-it-is.statement: Zscaler Health360 gives centralized visibility into the deployment, health and performance of the Zscaler environment, removing manual analysis across product consoles and custom reports, and helps monitor active subscriptions, deployment status, configuration quality and the value delivered.

quotes: Zscaler Health360 delivers centralized visibility into the deployment, health, and performance of your Zscaler environment.
it eliminates the manual analysis often required across multiple product consoles, interfaces, and custom reports
This service helps you easily monitor your active subscriptions, deployment status, configuration quality, and the overall value being delivered.

categories.statement: Health360 covers four categories: Services (ISP networks, Zero Trust Exchange infrastructure and applications, with ISP-network and application health data powered by ZDX), Connectors (devices that connect to the Zero Trust Exchange, with versions, performance, capacity and health signals), Best Practices, and Adoption (deployment, entitlement and utilization per product).

quotes: Services: This category encompasses all aspects of the third-party ecosystem used to access applications.
This includes ISP networks, Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) infrastructure, and applications.
The ISP networks and applications health data is powered by Digital Experience (ZDX), your digital experience monitoring product.
Connectors: This category focuses on the various devices used to connect to the Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE).
Health360 provides actionable insights into these devices, including versions, performance, capacity, and health signals.
Best Practices: This category displays the best practices distilled from Zscaler's extensive experience
Adoption: This category displays Zscaler platform adoption maturity by detailing deployment, entitlement, and utilization levels on a per-product basis.

views.statement: The Analytics overview lists Health360's dashboards as Best Practices, Connectors Health, China Connectivity (a near real-time overview of China Premium bandwidth utilization against purchased bandwidth), Adoption and Executive Insights.

quotes: Dashboards and reports: Best Practices: Displays the best practices distilled from Zscaler's extensive experience
Connectors Health: Focuses on the various devices used to connect to the Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE).
China Connectivity: Provides a near real-time overview of your China Premium connectivity, which gives you visibility into the current and historic bandwidth utilization against purchased bandwidth.
Adoption: Displays Zscaler platform adoption maturity by detailing deployment, entitlement, and utilization levels on a per-product basis.
Executive Insights: Provides a high-level overview of the applications, network, cloud, and incidents in your organization.

dashboard-time-range.statement: The Health360 dashboard (Analytics > Health360) can show metrics from the last 24 hours, 48 hours, 7 days or 30 days.

quotes: To customize your data evaluation, you can adjust the dashboard view to display metrics from the last 24 hours, 48 hours, 7 days, or 30 days.
On the Health360 dashboard page (Analytics > Health360), you can:

overall-score.statement: The overall health score (0-100) is averaged from all the categories of Health360 and banded Green 90-100 Healthy, Amber 70-89 Moderate, Red 40-69 Degraded and Crimson Red 0-39 Critical.

quotes: View your overall health score (0–100) averaged from all the categories of Health360.
Green: A score of 90–100 is categorized as Healthy.
Amber: A score of 70–89 is categorized as Moderate.
Red: A score of 40–69 is categorized as Degraded.
Crimson Red: A score of 0–39 is categorized as Critical.

category-scores.statement: The dashboard shows a Best Practices score (health signals for optimal configuration, resilience and performance), a Connectors Health score (health signals from devices such as Client Connector, App Connector and tunnels) and a Service Health score (signals such as availability, ISP network latency, Zero Trust Exchange and application performance), with a health score trend graph for the filter time frame.

quotes: Best Practices: View the best practices score based on health signals for optimal configuration, resilience, and performance factors.
Connectors Health: View the score based on health signals from devices such as Zscaler Client Connector, App Connector, tunnels, etc.
Service Health: View the score based on health signals like availability, ISP network latency, Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE), application performance, etc.
It also contains the health score trend graph for the filter time frame.

regions-and-incidents.statement: Overall Health by Regions shows regions with health indicators, each showing on hover its overall score and per-category breakdown, and Incidents Impacting Your Health Score lists the top incidents affecting the overall score.

quotes: Overall Health by Regions: View regions across the globe with health indicators.
Hover over each indicator to view the overall health score along with the breakdown for each category for that region.
Incidents Impacting Your Health Score: View top incidents impacting your overall health score.

best-practices-score.statement: The Best Practices page (Analytics > Health360 > Best Practices) evaluates configuration posture against Zscaler's recommended guidelines for each deployed Zscaler service; its score (0-100) is banded Green 90-100 Healthy, Amber 70-89 Moderate, Red 40-69 Degraded and Crimson Red 0-39 Critical, and its trend graph covers the previous month.

quotes: The Best Practices page evaluates your configuration posture against Zscaler's recommended guidelines for each deployed Zscaler service.
Best Practices Score: View the overall best practices score (0–100).
Green: A score of 90–100 is categorized as Healthy.
Amber: A score of 70–89 is categorized as Moderate.
Red: A score of 40–69 is categorized as Degraded.
Crimson Red: A score of 0–39 is categorized as Critical.
Health Score Trend: View the health score trend graph for the previous month.

best-practices-table.statement: Practices are split into Resiliency and Performance; each table row gives a Status of Followed or Not Followed, the Product, a Percent Compliant (only 100% compliant practices count as Followed), a Priority of Medium or High, and Recommendations with the remediation steps.

quotes: Switch between Resiliency and Performance practices in the following table.
Status: The status of the best practice, whether it's implemented or not (Followed or Not Followed).
Product: The Zscaler service associated with the best practice.
Percent Compliant: The percentage at which the best practice is currently compliant.
Only 100% compliant practices are categorized as Followed in the Status column.
Priority: The priority for the practice (Medium or High).
Recommendations: The remediation steps to implement the practice.

practice-details.statement: A practice's details page gives its Category (Resiliency or Performance), Product, Priority (based on severity), Recommendation and Percent Followed, and a table of the parameters involved (for example policy name, forwarding profile, server, ports) whose filter options and data vary by practice.

quotes: Category: The category of the best practice (Resiliency or Performance).
Product: The Zscaler product the best practice belongs to.
Priority: The priority for addressing the practice based on its severity.
Recommendation: Zscaler's recommendation on how to implement the best practice.
Percent Followed: The best practice implementation percentage.
A table where you can view the data for each parameter involved in the practice (e.g., policy name, forwarding profile, server, ports).
The filter options and the table data vary based on the best practice you choose to analyze.

connectors-health-scope.statement: The Connectors Health page (Analytics > Health360 > Connectors Health) evaluates the health of Zscaler connectors, Private Service Edges, Client Connector and tunnels, for location-based diagnostics (offline, degraded or unreachable components by region or site), capacity management (overloaded connectors, saturated tunnels, uneven traffic distribution) and lifecycle management (connector versions, upgrade compliance, end-of-support risks).

quotes: The Connectors Health page evaluates the health of your devices, such as Zscaler connectors, Private Service Edges, Zscaler Client Connector, and tunnels.
On the Connectors Health page (Analytics > Health360 > Connectors Health), you can:
Location-Based Diagnostics: Rapidly identify offline, degraded, or unreachable components by region or site.
Capacity Management: Detect overloaded connectors, saturated tunnels, and uneven traffic distribution.
Lifecycle Management: Track connector versions, upgrade compliance, and end-of-support risks.

connectors-health-view.statement: Connectors Health can show the last 24 hours, 48 hours, 7 days, 30 days or a custom range; its score (0-100) is banded Green 90-100 Healthy, Amber 70-89 Moderate, Red 40-69 Degraded and Crimson Red 0-39 Critical, and clicking the trend graph shows the health of all devices and the events affecting the score at that date and time.

quotes: you can adjust the dashboard view to display metrics for the last 24 hours, 48 hours, 7 days, 30 days, or a custom range.
Connectors Health Score: View the overall connectors health score (0–100).
Green: A score of 90–100 is categorized as Healthy.
Amber: A score of 70–89 is categorized as Moderate.
Red: A score of 40–69 is categorized as Degraded.
Crimson Red: A score of 0–39 is categorized as Critical.
Click any part of the trend graph to view the health of all the devices and events impacting the health score for that specific date and time.

connectors-health-locations.statement: Locations With Connectors shows device health by country, sortable by Most Impacted, Name or Locations Count, with a map switchable between Offices and Remote locations and filterable by health status.

quotes: Locations With Connectors: View the health status of devices by country.
Sort this list for the country by Most Impacted, Name, or Locations Count.
Switch the map for devices in Offices or Remote locations.
Filter the data in the map for a specific health status by selecting the health status at the top right.

scoring.title: How Health360 scores are weighted and which signals feed them
scoring.detail: The dashboard shows three category scores (Best Practices, Connectors Health, Service Health) and says the overall score is averaged from all categories, while the What Is Health360 page lists four categories (Adoption has no score). The pages do not give weights, the signals and thresholds behind each score, or what the incidents impacting the score are and where they come from.

best-practices.title: The Best Practices catalogue, priority values and the Percent Compliant versus Percent Followed figure
best-practices.detail: The pages give no catalogue of practices. The details page says Priority is based on severity but lists no values, while the table gives Medium or High. The table calls the figure Percent Compliant and the details page Percent Followed; the pages do not say whether these are the same.

retention.title: How long Health360 data is retained and where it is stored
retention.detail: The Health360 help pages cited here do not cover retention or storage. The vendor capture logs-fair-use-zscaler-health360-logs.json is a fair-use page on Health360 logs that has not been extracted into this subject, so no claim is made from it.
